articles.title: Xbox Tokyo Game Show 2026 Live Report — Everything Announced
articles.summary: Microsoft is at Tokyo Game Show 2026 with a special broadcast event, and IGN is reporting live on all the news, trailers, and talking points. The action kicks off on Thursday, September 17 at 3am PT / 6am / ET / 11am UK / 7pm JST, with 'Xbox Tokyo Game Show 2026 Broadcast.' Microsoft has said to…
body: “Our annual Tokyo Game Show broadcast is proof of what is possible when creativity from across the region meets a truly global platform and Xbox is committed to being the stage where new and beloved franchises reach players around the world,” Microsoft continued. The show will also be broadcast with American Sign Language (ASL), and English Audio Descriptions (AD).

So, what should we expect from the broadcast? I think for Xbox fans, it’s worth managing expectations. Xbox has Minecraft Dungeons 2 and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 at TGS itself, so I wouldn’t be surprised if we see both games during the broadcast. It’s worth remembering that Playground’s Forza Horizon 6 is set in Japan, so maybe now would be a good time for an update on future content — and that pesky PS5 version.

Beyond that, I expect to see games from Asian studios that are currently working with Xbox. Maybe RGG Studio’s Stranger Than Heaven, which we know is down to be a day one launch on Game Pass, will turn up with a new trailer. Team Ninja’s Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember is also due out early next year and is set for Game Pass, so maybe we’ll see it there, too.

articles.title: MTG Marvel Super Heroes Bundles Are Back in Stock on Amazon
articles.summary: Magic: The Gathering players will know all too well the struggle to find Collector Boosters when a set launches. These packs are pricey to begin with, but then scalpers complicate things. And since these are the best way to earn some of the rarest cards in a set, it’s bound to keep happening.
body: While we are starting to see Marvel Super Heroes Collector Boosters pop up a little more often, it’s not often we see a solid deal on a bundle that includes one. Thankfully, you can snag one such bundle for the set from Amazon right now at a slight discount.

The Marvel Super Heroes Gift Edition Bundle is an ideal way to build a collection pretty quickly for anyone who’s keen on getting into Magic. The nice box doubles as storage, and you get nine Play Boosters inside.
There’s also an exclusive alternative art card exclusive to the bundle, and 30 land cards that include full-art, foil, and non-foil options, plus a special die.

Still, the real draw is undeniably the Collector Booster, which would make up almost half of the price of the box on its own. These cards are packed with rare cards and alternative art treatments, making them the best place to find the Marvel Super Heroes set’s most valuable cards.

articles.title: Monster Hunter Wilds upcoming expansion, Ascendance, reveals an infamous returning monster - and it looks like it'll address the difficulty complaints
articles.summary: Brace yourselves, everyone: the Monster Hunter Wilds Ascendance marketing machine is spinning up. Today, at Tokyo Game Show, Capcom released the an extended cut of the first official trailer for Ascendance, revealing the explosion-loving leonine monster, Teostra, as a huntable foe.
body: The infamously tricky Elder Dragon was first introduced way back in Monster Hunter 2 in 2006, its penchanct for blast effects and flame breath pushing the PS2 tech quite hard at the time. Though the developer has made some pretty decent improvements to how the game runs since launch, it does seem that the beast's fiery attacks chew up the bitrate in the trailer a little. Here's hoping that isn't a reflection of the performance in-game.

One thing I did notice in this trailer is that the infamously tricky Teo fight looks even harder in the footage we've seen so far. Granted, the trailer is only three minutes-long (the real fight will probably take 10x that, in real-time), but it seems Capcom has given everyone's favourite exploding lion a little more utility than we saw in his last appearance in Monster Hunter Rise - Sunbreak.

articles.title: Stranger Things: Tales From ’85 Season 2 Review
articles.summary: Stranger Things: Tales From ’85 Season 2 review: The animated Stranger Things spin-off still suffers from underwhelming stories and a lack of stakes.
body: Stranger Things: Tales From ’85 Season 2 debuts September 17 on Netflix.

Intrigued, the HIC quickly discover that the flowers are actually Audrey II-looking critters being harvested by glowing blue “hate sprites,” as dubbed by Max, and they’re not friendly. In fact, they’re harbingers of a bigger ghost-like creature that’s on the hunt for humans. Across the eight episodes of this season, the kids will determine why they’ve shown up, how they tie into the lore of Hawkins’ founding, and deal with some other unfinished business from last season.

On the character front, the impending romantic holiday brings out the worst in Max (Jolie Hoang-Rappaport), who picks plenty of fights with Lucas (Elisha “EJ” Williams), which ties into their canon on again/off again status referred to in Season 3 of the live-action series. Eleven (Brooklyn Davey Norstedt) and Mike (Luca Diaz) also continue to figure out what they are, even though Eleven remains as fiercely protective of Mike as ever.

articles.title: PlayStation 5's latest firmware update takes Community Activity out of beta, but it's missing a key feature
articles.summary: A new PlayStation 5 firmware update has officially arrived for everyone, after about a month of testing. The change log for firmware version 26.06-14.00.00 has changed in one major way since the beta first went live in August.
body: The Community Activity widget is now available for all players to add to their console's Welcome Hub. Community Activity wasn't part of the firmware's beta, but Sony has been testing the feature since May.

Community Activity has two views: Trending Now, and Top 10. Trending Now shows a list of 10 multiplayer games (or multiplayer modes within games) that are rising in popularity across PlayStation. This is where you can expect to see recently-updated games, hot new releases and games that got a sale bump. Each game tile also shows what pushed the game to get on that list, such as a surge in matches or hours played.

Top 10 is more straightforward, and it shows a list of the 10 most popular games over the last week. This ranking varies depending on your country or region, making it more accurate. You can probably expect these to be roughly the same week-to-week, though, if previous data is anything to go by. The only problem? Top 10 used to list player counts for each game in the beta, but that is gone from the final version.
points: A new PlayStation 5 firmware update has officially arrived for everyone, after about a month of testing.
The change log for firmware version 26.06-14.00.00 has changed in one major way since the beta first went live in August.

articles.title: 20 Years Ago, Sega Introduced the World to Its Greatest Hero of All Time
articles.summary: Even if you’ve never played a single one of Sega’s Yakuza games, you’ve undoubtedly seen the memes — the chicken in the bowling alley, the Friday night boogie at the disco, the profoundly earnest karaoke, the perils of mahjong.
body: After serving a ten-year sentence for a crime he didn’t commit, Yakuza sees Kiryu return to his old stomping grounds in Tokyo’s vice district. There, he’s tasked with tracking down 10 billion yen that’s been stolen from the Tojo Clan and investigating the mysterious disappearance of his childhood friend — and longtime crush — Yumi. Along the way, he unravels a conspiracy that threatens the leadership of the Tojo Clan, faces betrayal from his closest friend, and becomes an unlikely father figure to a vulnerable young girl.

articles.title: Konami's Castlevania: Belmont's Curse Plays Like.a Dream
articles.summary: Konami's welcome revival of its most beloved franchises, including Silent Hill and Metal Gear Solid, is coming for Castlevania. The next game in the franchise, Castlevania: Belmont's Curse, looks to bring back the series' side-scrolling exploration and 2D platforming combat in the style of Symphony…
body: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse is the first new mainline game in the franchise in more than a decade — excluding the remade Haunted Castle, that is — and already feels like a worthy successor to the name. After spending 20 minutes with Belmont's Curse at Tokyo Game Show, my enthusiasm for the new Castlevania has skyrocketed. From the first minute, developer Evil Empire delivers a slick, polished, and gorgeous new adventure.

Belmont's Curse is set in 15th-century Paris and stars Rose Belmont, daughter of Trevor Belmont and Sypha Belnades, and the latest in a long line of vampire hunters. Rose boasts the fighting prowess of her father and the arcane abilities of her mother, the latter of which manifests in the form of tarot cards that unlock special abilities and facets of the game's story. Initially, Rose fights with a sword and spells, but after an encounter with the game's first boss, a mysterious brute named The Fallen, she earns Castlevania's signature weapon, a whip that instantly opens up the combat and platforming mechanics of Belmont's Curse 's.

articles.title: Slow Horses Season 6, Episode 1 Review — 'Circle of Life'
articles.summary: Apple TV's spy series Slow Horses is back just a year after Season 5 with a Season 6 premiere that's still feels as familiar as ever, even with new writing leadership.
body: This review contains full spoilers for Slow Horses Season 6, Episode 1, which is streaming on Apple TV now.

It’s the return of Slow Horses (along with a Season 8 confirmation )! The questions looming over this new six-episode season were how well it would fare after losing its creator and head writer, Will Smith, while tackling two of Mick Herron’s Slough House novels instead of one. So far, Slow Horses seems the same as ever, even if it’s maybe trying a little too hard to prove that it knows how the show’s schtick is supposed to go. Even so, it’s hard to be too nitpicky with a series that cranks out new seasons like clockwork and reliably hits its marks.

articles.title: 60 Years Ago, the Best Charlie Brown Quote Was So Perfect It Made It Into the Movie
articles.summary: Lucy’s quote, “Happiness is a warm puppy,” is another great one that touches on life’s simple joys on a really deep level. But to determine the best quote ever uttered by Charlie Brown, I didn't want accidental brilliance, I wanted something that he understands as much as the audience does.
body: Many of the best Peanuts quotes involve the characters saying something accidentally brilliant. While a line might be intentionally insightful when it was generated in the mind of their creator Charles Schulz, when they transfer from his mind to the mouths of his creations, it's usually them saying something brilliant without ever meaning to or noticing that they did. For example, the best line about heartbreak from Peanuts is “Nothing takes the taste out of peanut butter like unrequited love!” That quote perfectly encapsulates the physiological sensation associated with romantic rejection, but for Charlie Brown, he’s just reacting to the feeling without any deeper intention.

articles.title: 33 Years Ago, 'X-Files' Introduced Its Weirdest Character in the Most Perfect Way Possible
articles.summary: The scene takes place in the office of FBI Division Chief Scott Blevins (Charles Cioffi) and it contains four characters: Blevins, Scully, another man who asks her questions along with Blevins (Ken Camroux), and a silent man who only stands in the corner, puffing away on a cigarette.
body: The Cigarette Smoking Man came about unexpectedly. In the first episode of The X-Files, we see the pivotal scene where FBI Agent Dana Scully (Gillian Anderson) is reassigned to the FBI’s paranormal cases unit — nicknamed “the X-Files” — to assist Agent Fox Mulder (David Duchovny). Mulder has seemingly become obsessed with these cases, and the FBI seems to be indirectly assigning Scully to discredit his work.

As William B. Davis, who played the Cigarette Smoking Man, has explained, he was merely cast in a non-speaking part for the pilot episode without any hint of what the character would become. But something about his steely look made the writers on The X-Files want to bring him back again and again. In time, the Cigarette Smoking Man became one of the most intriguing, important, long-running characters in the entire series.

By contrast, in the second episode of The X-Files, another mysterious figure was introduced that was intended to be a major recurring character in the series. And while he didn’t last as long in the show as the Cigarette Smoking Man, he certainly made an impact that fans still remember.

articles.title: Metroid Ravenous Logo Memes Make Phrases Like “Girl Dinner” And “They Took My Ass” Look So Metal
articles.summary: Hype emanating from the reveal of Metroid Ravenous has translated into an onslaught of memes after a logo generator circulated online. If you're on Reddit or Bluesky, you may have seen the instantly iconic image of Samus Aran aggressively pinning down a mysterious enemy for consumption, but now…
body: The Pixelframe Design website unveiled a tool that lets anyone input any text and style it to look like the grainy and jagged Metroid Ravenous logo, with four options for the image background. Pixelframe Design previously made similar logo generators for games like GTA 6, The Duskbloods, and famously, Pokopia.

The apparent hook of Metroid Ravenous is Samus's need to kill and consume her enemies to survive. Naturally, that has led to food-related memes like a riff on the "55 burgers" scene from I Think You Should Leave, a reference to the viral concept of "girl dinner," or a simple but effective "Om Nom Nom" joke. Literally any wording you put into the generator will look more badass in this font.

It's also been amusing to see other video game titles like Hello Kitty Island Adventure in the Ravenous font face, and several other of these memes are just vulgar and gross enough to be hilarious. Don't expect any of this to become official Nintendo marketing material.

The Metroid subreddit was briefly jam-packed with these images, leading to moderators creating a megathread devoted to the meme template. Hilariously, many of the top-upvoted comments are Ravenous memes dunking on the mods.

articles.title: Resident Evil Director Was In Horrible Pain Making The Movie
articles.summary: Resident Evil director Zach Cregger has revealed he was going through hell while making the movie, which is about a man going through hell. He told The Hollywood Reporter that he had pneumonia for the first half of filming on Resident Evil.
body: "So I was very, very ill for the whole production, and everything felt so barely in control because my body was failing me," Cregger explained.

Cregger said he credits his "wonderful, talented" department leads to help him through, while he also praised Resident Evil star Austin Abrams for going above and beyond. He said Abrams is "one of the most can-do, positive people I’ve ever met. I was spoiled by the people around me."

Not only was Cregger physically sick while making Resident Evil, he had to deal with freezing-cold conditions in the north of the Czech Republic where the movie was filmed. "We froze our asses off," he said.
This wasn't the first time Cregger was dealing with physical turmoil while making a movie. On his last film, Weapons, it was so hot and humid that he needed an IV and directed scenes remotely.

articles.title: Wardogs studio CEO issues new statement, after backlash for saying his studio won't hire people who "constantly tweet anti-crunch messaging"
articles.summary: Joe Brammer, CEO of Bulkhead, the developer behind The Turing Test, Battalion 1944, and now the hugely successful new release Wardogs, has found himself in somewhat hot water, following a revealing interview where he discussed work culture at the UK studio.
body: After a day of heated social media debate and an initial response via X, Brammer has now issued a statement to Eurogamer. In it, he explains the exact nature of the studio's "crunch" practices, and clarifies that his mention of monitoring the social media of potential applicants to the studio - a potential legal grey area in the UK - was a case of "speaking informally about our culture".

To rewind a little, the response to Brammer's comments began following his recent appearance on The Game Business, where he discussed a number of topics around the culture and running of the Bulkhead studio and, when the conversation shifted to crunch, revealed he expects his team to do so where necessary.

articles.title: Resident Evil Is Now The Highest-Rated Gaming Movie Ever
articles.summary: The Resident Evil movie from Weapons and Barbarian director Zach Cregger releases in theaters on September 18. Reviews from critics went live today, and the movie is earning high scores.
body: In fact, it's now the highest-rated video game movie ever. It boasts a mightily impressive 96% on Rotten Tomatoes from 71 reviews and an equally impressive 80 on GameSpot sister site Metacritic. According to Metacritic, Resident Evil is the highest-rated video game movie ever, well ahead of another 2026 movie, Exit 8, which has a 71 Metascore.

The six Resident Evil movies that Paul W.S. Anderson made did not score very high with critics, with 2016's The Final Chapter topping them all at 49% on Metacritic. The latest Resident Evil movie before Cregger's, 2021's Welcome to Raccoon City from director Johannes Roberts, scored a 44% on Metacritic.

After that movie came out, Constantin, which has owned the movie rights to Resident Evil since the '90s, intended to put the franchise on hiatus. However, Cregger, coming off the success of Barbarian, pitched Constantin on his new, original take, and Constantin loved it so much that they put it into production.

articles.title: Lego Batman: Legacy Of The Dark Knight Gives Harley Quinn An Arkham Asylum Makeover
articles.summary: Lego Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight was a fun tribute to the Caped Crusader when it launched earlier this year, but if you're tired of saving Gotham, you can embrace chaos with two of the city's greatest villains: Harley Quinn and the Joker.
body: While Harley Quinn predominantly wore a jester's outfit throughout her appearances in Batman: The Animated Series and related comic books, Rocksteady's Arkham Asylum game saw her switch up her look dramatically for what can best be described as a doctor-themed dominatrix. Out with the spandex onesie, in with a repurposed doctor's outfit, leather corset, domino mask, and other elements that paid homage to her roots. In Lego Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight, this costume is described as having prankster pigtails and a "chaotic" corset.

In case you missed it, the Mayhem Collection draws heavily from Batman: The Animated Series, with developer TT Games calling the expansion a love letter to the landmark '90s show that introduced Harley Quinn as the Joker's sidekick. Fans can find several references to the series in the Mayhem Collection, along with Easter eggs for other Batman shows, films, games, and comic book stories. There's even a nod to Harley Quinn's original voice actor, the late Arleen Sorkin, and the new story mission chronicles the first meeting between the Joker and Quinn, back when she was still the ambitious psychiatrist Dr. Harleen Quinzel.

body: With Steam Frame just missing the embargo for the last DF Direct, John, Rich and Oliver share impressions of Valve's latest hardware plus there's some ARM standalone testing of Half-Life Alyx, Cyberpunk 2077 and Streets of Rage 4. Beyond that, it's Supporter Q+A time: why doesn't From Software fix 30fps frame-pacing issues? If DLSS 5 isn't really DLSS, how should DLSS evolve? Finally... with the legendary Kallax having been modded into Skyrim by Ikea, what other Scandinavian furniture should be added to the game?!

videos.title: Blackwood - Official Launch Trailer
videos.summary: Take a look at the Launch Trailer for Blackwood, a third-person action shooter developed by AttritoM7 Productions. Players will take on the city of Blackwood, with all of its trials and tribulations at the forefront.
points: Take a look at the Launch Trailer for Blackwood, a third-person action shooter developed by AttritoM7 Productions.
Players will take on the city of Blackwood, with all of its trials and tribulations at the forefront.
Organize the day-to-day operations of a DVD store by day while becoming entrenched in the criminal underworld by night.
Live the dangerous double life in Blackwood, available now on PC (Steam).
